children: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions called for clear boundaries on AI-powered security data access and highlighted SOC 2 Type 2 validation.
RAD urged clearer rules on access, sharing and use of data from AI security and license-plate systems amid national debate.
RAD says its devices keep LPR data in customer-specific environments and do not use facial recognition in current deployments.
Company completed a SOC 2 Type 2 audit, validating operations and internal controls for data protection and security.
Leadership to present "Operator 2.0" at GSX 2026, discussing AI-driven changes to security staffing and operations.
